summary: This CSS styles a blog post series component that displays a numbered list of related posts. The main container has a colored background, left border, and smooth transitions, while the list items use CSS counters to auto-number themselves instead of using bullet points. It includes styling for the current post highlight and a dark mode override.

explanations.2: This uses a CSS variable (custom property) that's defined elsewhere in the design system, allowing the background color to change globally if needed.
explanations.8: This makes the background, text color, and border smoothly animate over 200 milliseconds when they change, creating a polished visual effect.
explanations.12: The paragraph inside the series box is styled as bold and italicized to make it stand out as a header or description.
explanations.19: Removes the default bullet points from the list so we can create a custom numbered style with CSS counters instead.
explanations.21: Resets the counter to zero so that the list numbering starts fresh from 1 for this particular list.
explanations.26: Increments the counter by 1 for each list item, which will be used to generate the auto-incrementing numbers.
explanations.35: The `::before` pseudo-element creates content that appears before each list item's text without being in the HTML.
explanations.36: Displays the current counter value (the auto-incremented number) as the content before each item.
explanations.43: Groups two selectors together to apply the same styling to both links and span elements inside list items.
explanations.63: This targets the dark mode version of the page (Docusaurus adds a data-attribute to the HTML root) and applies different colors appropriate for dark backgrounds.
